scope: Post-hoc descriptive comparison, motivated by the new detector's misses on seq8 and seq11 and its stronger performance on the C6 still-image validation center. The sequence frames, C6 labels and earlier outcomes have already been inspected; no new model inference, thresholds, redetection, training or tuning are performed.
measurement: For every labeled-positive image in the curated C1-C5 training and C6 validation splits, compute the fraction of image area occupied by the tight bounding rectangle of the union binary mask and the fraction of foreground pixels. Compute the same two measurements for the already scored labeled-present original initialization frames seq8 and seq11. Use identical mask-decoding conventions and preverified label hashes. Compare sequence values with training and C6 empirical distributions; this union-mask box is not necessarily an individual-object box.
controls: On C6 only, descriptively summarize union-mask box area for images with and without an existing candidate top-one detection, using the already frozen, verified detector outputs; compare against the original detector too. These predictions are assessed on the same C6 used to select the checkpoint. No confidence threshold or selection policy is changed.
interpretation: Large or small area differences are an association, not proof of why a detector missed a frame. Two selected sequence frames, patient/video overlap uncertainty, possible mask annotation differences, and reuse of validation data prevent generalization. The diagnostic is not a video efficacy test.
